name: muxbase-desktop
description: MuxBase — the agentic IDE and mission control for a fleet of AI coding agents. Run Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Pi in parallel, each in its own git worktree and tmux pane.
author: MuxBase contributors

scripts.release:verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e:features && pnpm test:e2e:stable && pnpm test:e2e:ui-release && pnpm test:e2e:update && pnpm test:smoke && pnpm package:smoke
